name: The Class of One Edu4All
format: remote sessions, teacher-led; 1 teacher to 40 students (1:40); live or recorded not stated
timings: Monday to Friday, Grades 1-5: 9:30 AM-12:30 PM (3 hours), Batch 1
timings_note: Only Batch 1 times are listed; other batches are not shown.

curriculum.summary: Follows the NCERT-based national framework (NEP 2020), taught in English with Hindi compulsory. Grades 1-5 also include co-curricular art, dance and fitness. Board exams are not part of this programme; CBSE is a separate programme.

fees_note: No amounts on the pages read. Instalments available; free trial classes; fees not refundable once paid; book sets bought separately.
how_to_check: FAQ page at theclassofone.com/faqs-edu4all.php covers fee terms; amounts come from enquiry or demo booking.
